pressure-flow-nomogram.title: Male pressure-flow classification
pressure-flow-nomogram.teachingPoint: BOOI equals Pdet at Qmax minus twice Qmax.
pressure-flow-nomogram.populationAndView: Adult male pressure-flow study; hypothetical dots
pressure-flow-nomogram.textEquivalent: BOOI equals Pdet at Qmax minus twice Qmax. Greater than 40 is obstructed, 20 through 40 is equivocal, and below 20 is unobstructed. At Qmax 10 mL/s, Pdet 40 gives BOOI 20, Pdet 60 gives 40, and Pdet 70 gives 50.
